articles.title: France’s Champagne deficit presents golden opportunity for SA’s Cap Classique
articles.description: The French wine industry is experiencing one of its lowest production outputs in the past three decades, severely affected by record heatwaves, prolonged summer drought and unseasonal spring frosts. In SA, it’s shaping up to be an early harvest as El Niño takes its toll. Stock up while you can.

articles.title: Stuart Scharnick granted R5,000 bail in firearm related charges despite State opposition
